title: Arbitrary-Depth Exponential HOMFLY-PT Fibers over Quiver Point-Counting Polynomials of Plabic Links and Knots
field: algebraic combinatorics, cluster algebras, and knot polynomials
decided_scope: Explicit connected simple non-reduced plabic link and knot families of arbitrary jet depth r >= 1 where a single quiver point-counting and Alexander fiber contains 2^m distinct two-variable HOMFLY-PT polynomials
open_boundaries: Reduced simple plabic graphs and mutation-equivalence invariance of full two-variable HOMFLY-PT polynomials
